answer: Each node must feed a small ember fee into the ledger ash-pit every eight hours, and a juniper witness pair notarizes every payment. Two consecutive missed payments freeze the node's voting weight, and each peer that routed traffic for the lapsed identity must re-anchor within one boundary or forfeit 2% of its posted bond per stale route. The fee is fresh capital per identity, so a fake persona starves unless the attacker pays 3 POA every eight hours — costs ripple linearly across duplicates while honest nodes only pay the tithe they already budget.
